messages:
emma: Quick heads-up: shipping SDK v4.1 at 19:00 PT today. Main points: legacy config keys (sdk_v3_compat) will be deprecated, docs reorganized for migration patterns, and a lightweight compatibility shim is available for 120 days. :megaphone:

emma: Breaking? only if you rely on old config keys. We will NOT flip any org settings automatically. Instead: 120-day deprecation window + opt-out tools for org admins.

ryan: Which keys exactly are deprecated?

emma: Ryan: the flags named `sdk_v3_compat`, `legacy_parse_mode`, and the `auto-patch` default. Full diff in the RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/sdk-deprecate-v3-keys

mohit: Docs note: I've added a migration guide with before/after snippets and a small conversion script. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migrate-v3-to-v4.1

gina: CLI admin snippet to mark an org exempt during the window?

mohit: Yes. Example:
```bash
redwood admin org update --org=myco --sdk.legacy_mode=keep
```

infra-bot: release/sdk v4.1 deployed to canary at 2026-03-24T19:00:02Z — status: success :white_check_mark:

docbot: docs/changeset created: changes/2026-03-24-sdk-4.1-deprecations.md preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-03-24-sdk-4.1

marketing-bot: Calendar reminder sent to customers on the "SDK Breaking Changes" list: 2026-03-24 19:05 PT (email + in-console banner).

ryan: Perf/regressions?

emma: No perf regressions in the benchsuite. The shim adds ~2-5MB to client installs for node/browser targets.

mohit: Action items: 1) Eng: add telemetry metric `deprecated_key_usage` and alert if >1% of requests in prod use the old keys. 2) Docs: add example transforms for parse->structured. 3) Support: prepare canned responses and migration offers.

gina: I'll own the support FAQ and canned responses.

emma: Thanks. We'll review the metrics in two weeks and schedule a follow-up notice at 60d and 14d before the hard removal. Post any questions here or ping me directly. END THREAD
